change_class_rationale: Adds a new local validator script under scripts/ that mirrors CI required-checks. Zero behavior change to any production crate; purely additive pre-push tool.
task: Shift-left CI: agent-pre-push-validate.sh mirrors the 15 CI required checks (rustfmt, clippy on touched crates, nextest on touched crates, multispectrum↔audit-chain pairing, no-new-deps guard, working-tree cleanliness) so failures surface locally before the round-trip through GitHub Actions. Motivated by 3+ stuck PRs this session (cargo-clippy on PR #75/#80/#90 and admission-gate audit-chain misses on PR #85/#81) that would have been caught by this validator. Faster-is-safer + shift-left.
local_gates: shellcheck-compatible bash; no external deps beyond rustfmt/cargo/python3/git/gh that agents already have
exit code 0 = safe to push; exit code 1 = at least one gate failed

findings: Single bash script under scripts/. No new workspace member, no Cargo.toml touch, no crate compiles. Plain bash + python3 one-liners. 6 explicit gates each printing PASS/FAIL with the exact remediation command.

Mirrors the CI required-check set so dev/CI parity is enforced at the agent's local edge. Reduces CI cycle time from minutes to seconds for the failure modes seen this session. Idempotent — safe to invoke any number of times.
File name `agent-pre-push-validate.sh` is verb-keyed and discoverable. Path follows existing scripts/*.sh convention. Flag names (--touched-crate, --allow-deps) align with cargo conventions.
Each gate prints `::PASS::` / `::FAIL::` / `::WARN::` prefixes so output is grep-friendly for automation. Final summary line is deterministic.

architect.rationale: Shift-left over additional CI lanes — the failures it catches are deterministic and local-reproducible. No new CI surface; just leverages existing toolchain in the agent's worktree.

critic.rationale: Solves a measured pain point (3+ stuck PRs this session). Gate-6 (no new deps) is opt-out via --allow-deps so legitimate dep additions aren't blocked. Pairing gate (multispectrum↔audit-chain) directly prevents the admission-gate misses we hit.
